shared_elements: repeated vertical linear elements (fluted columns / incised parallel grooves)
horizontal banding of the carved surface
justification: Both show shallow carving on stone with disc/circle motifs, some horizontal banding and anthropomorphic imagery, but that is about as far as the correspondence goes. A is a wide, framed, brightly coloured picture of an architectural terrace with orderly processional friezes and legible detail, while B is a single weathered, monolithic vertical figure whose eroded motifs float without any banded processional order.
